proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ _ _ A B hA hA'
  have ha : (A.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hA.card_ne_zero
  have ha' : (Aᶜ.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hA'.card_ne_zero
  have h : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hd : Disjoint (A ∩ B) (Aᶜ ∩ B) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro x hx hx'; simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_compl] at hx hx'; exact hx'.1 hx.1
  have hu : (A ∩ B) ∪ (Aᶜ ∩ B) = B := by
    ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_compl]; tauto
  have hc : (B.card : ℝ) = (A ∩ B).card + (Aᶜ ∩ B).card := by
    have := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd
    rw [hu] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  rw [hc]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (A B : Finset Ω), A.Nonempty → Aᶜ.Nonempty → (B.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω = ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) * (((A ∩ B).card : ℝ) / A.card) + ((Aᶜ.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) * ((Aᶜ ∩ B).card / Aᶜ.card)
